svg.title: Retail inventory oscillation
svg.desc: A causal-loop diagram of Retail inventory oscillation. 4 variables are joined by 4 causal links, each carrying its polarity beside the arrowhead. The engine's job here is to find the feedback loops and classify them by Sterman's even/odd rule, and this drawing shows that answer: B1 runs Inventory → Perceived stock gap → Order rate → Inbound deliveries → Inventory with 1 negative link, so it balances. The slow link wears two hash marks. Each loop glyph is a circular arrow curling in the loop's own direction, labelled with the computed letter and the loop's name.
